description: Source code implementing a test harness for hashmap performance testing, including functions for creating entries, hashing, and executing performance tests based on command input.

methods.name: test_entry_cmp
methods.description: Compares two hashmap entries or a key with an entry, optionally ignoring case.

methods.name: alloc_test_entry
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new test_entry with given hash, key, and value.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value based on the specified method, index, and key.

methods.name: perf_hashmap
methods.description: Performs performance testing of hashmap add or lookup operations based on parameters.

methods.name: cmd__hashmap
methods.description: Main command function that reads commands from stdin and executes hashmap performance tests.
